title: Lavandula latifolia tea for medicinal use
intro: Lavandula latifolia tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried leaves and flowers of the broadleaf lavender plant. It is commonly used in herbalism for its calming and soothing properties. This tea is often consumed to alleviate stress, anxiety, and promote relaxation. It may also aid in improving sleep quality and reducing inflammation. In traditional medicine, it is valued for its aromatic and mild sedative effects.
